trainer/30514.htm.text: Prefect Vokiyan: Welcome. I teach Orc Fighters, Raiders and Monks. Why have you come to see me?

trainer/30514-noteach.htm.text: Prefect Vokian: You, fool! The great power of the ORcs is invincible! Don't you know that your race is lacking in all things, and will never be able to grasp the arts of the ORcs, no matter how hard you may train!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30514-03.htm.text: Prefect Vokian: Have you heard? All of the Orc seers agree that an eternal winter is approaching! It won't be long... We Orcs must prepare for dark days; days of chaos and destruction, dreadful days of endless war and disaster! People like you are indolent and weak. We are stronger than anyone else…

links.text: "I shall participate in the reconstruction of the kingdom!"

You should be able to extract some information from them! If you should find a snake-shaped amulet please bring it to me!

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
